inputs.help: SRT or WebVTT cues. Add data drops an existing .srt or .vtt file straight in, so you never need the speech model. Transcribe fills this from the clip where on-device speech is available; the CLI has none, so this field is the CLI path.

inputs.label: Caption style
inputs.help: Bar runs the full width, Box hugs the words, Outline drops the fill and keeps a readable edge, Karaoke lights each word as it is spoken.

inputs.label: Lines per cue
inputs.help: How many lines a cue is split across. A very long cue still wraps to fit the frame.

inputs.label: Show timecode
inputs.help: Prints the cue's in and out times above the words. Handy for review, rarely wanted in a finished frame.

inputs.label: Burn captions in
inputs.help: On, the cue is drawn over the frame. Off, the frame stays clean and the words travel in the .srt and .vtt sidecars instead.

inputs.label: Preview time
inputs.help: Which second of the clip the still shows. The cue covering this moment is the one drawn.
